Class UIStyle

java.lang.Object
library.ui.UIStyle
public final class UIStyle extends Object
Central place for the application's look: colour palette, fonts and factory methods for consistently styled buttons, text fields, combo boxes, cards, tables and dialogs.
Author:
Usman
